title: money INT64_MIN / -1; RISC-V division never traps, so it returns a wrong value
live_proof: no fix commit recorded. Established by arithmetic on the pin rather than by a sanitizer: '-92233720368547758.08'::money is exactly INT64_MIN cents, and dividing it by -1 has no representable answer. x86 raises SIGFPE; RISC-V does not trap and cash_div_int64 returns INT64_MIN unchanged, which the purecap run prints
fidelity: real server. There is no memory error here and nothing for a capability machine to catch -- the defect is arithmetic, and the evidence is the value. Recorded so the corpus's denominator is not quietly restricted to memory safety
